explication: MimiClaw is an ESP32-S3 AI assistant: users send messages through chat or a local interface; channel adapters queue them for the agent, which builds context, consults an LLM and tools, uses persistent memory, and returns a response through outbound dispatch. The product also includes WiFi onboarding, scheduled and heartbeat messages, skills, a WebSocket gateway, and device tools. Runtime wiring is supported by the excerpts and source index; tool implementations and some auxiliary subsystems were not sampled, so uncertain links are marked dashed.
